blocks.text:
In the morning, take an early flight from Tortuguero to San José. This domestic flight is included in the programme.

On arrival, begin a day of sightseeing in central Costa Rica.

The first stop is the Doka coffee plantation.

Learn about the main stages of coffee production: growing, harvesting, processing and roasting the beans.

After the coffee tour, continue to La Paz Waterfall Gardens.

A trail leads through the forest to the waterfalls. Lunch is also included here.

In addition to the waterfalls, La Paz has a hummingbird gallery, serpentarium, aviary, butterfly garden and frog exhibit.

After the tour, return to San José.

Overnight at Exe San Jose Center.

Breakfast and lunch are included.
